name: Master Halren Voss
dialogue: A shield is not a wall, recruit. A wall waits. A Bulwark chooses where the danger is allowed to go.
reaction: Halren marks your stance as passable, which from him is basically a parade.

name: Pilgrim Renn
dialogue: The shrine bell rang last night, but nobody touched it. I am trying very hard not to think about what that means.
reaction: Renn keeps close behind you on the road, visibly relieved when you hold the Frontline.

name: Roadwarden Ila
dialogue: The road is Concord-safe on paper. Wolves and dead pilgrims have not signed the paper.
reaction: Ila files your name under useful, not decorative.

name: Shrinekeeper Olla
dialogue: The Little Dawn bell only opens inward for someone willing to stand between the traveler and the dark.
reaction: Olla lights one more candle on the rail and gives you permission to descend.
